text:
Zayne Parekh is the story in Calgary this month. The ninth pick in 2024, still 20, is quarterbacking the top power play, and five of his eight points have come there. The headlines have caught up: Daily Faceoff says he's "blossoming into a star", and he's become a fantasy waiver add.

The underlying line is good, not yet great. His 1.31 points per 60 beats the league average for defensemen, and he's at 0.40 points a game, well above the 0.25 median for defensemen picked 7th to 11th in their first full season. At five on five the Flames are slightly better with him than without, though the chances split close to even. Our talent range sits a bit below his current pace, so expect the points to level off rather than climb.

What makes him worth watching is the passing. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him at 5.9 primary shot assists per 60 last season (86th percentile among defensemen), though that's only seven tracked games. His minutes are trending up, past 21 a night in three of his last four. Calgary is giving him the keys.
